model: Life and P&C insurer FCFE at cost of equity, net debt held at zero (engine route)

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 total revenues as the CSV defines them (IFRS 17 insurance revenue 65,066 + investment income + other). Not premiums: GWP was RMB150.7bn in FY2025 (+17.4%); Sunshine Life GWP 102,611 (+27.5%), Sunshine P&C OPI 47,888 (+0.1%). H1 FY2026 total revenues 46,305 vs 45,119 (+2.6%). Revenue is only the engine's scaling base; the earnings measure is profit before tax.
inputs.share_count_basis: 11,502m shares in issue (3,478,768,513 H shares + ~8,023m domestic unlisted shares, H1 FY2026 interim report substantial-shareholder note; weighted average 11,502m in FY2024 and FY2025, basic = diluted, no share scheme, no convertibles). Domestic and H shares rank pari passu for dividends so per-share value is on the total count and compared to the H-share price. Held FLAT.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the banks/insurers convention in this folder (1336.HK, 2378.HK, LGEN.L, PRU, GL). Bonds payable RMB17,397m at 30 June 2026 (19,522 at FY2025) are capital supplementary bonds whose coupon (finance costs ~RMB1.1bn) is deducted inside profit before tax, so the flows already pay for them. Repo liabilities (27,661 at FY2025) are investment-operations funding, not corporate debt. Cash 42,956 is policyholder/investment liquidity inside RMB640bn+ of investment assets, not shareholder surplus. Solvency surplus (Group comprehensive 185%, core 132% at 30 June 2026; Sunshine Life 161% / 111%) is the regulatory buffer and is NOT added back.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 final dividend declared, RMB0.19 per share x 11,502m = RMB2,185m (FY2025 AR directors' report; no interim dividend is paid). 34.6% of attributable net profit of 6,307. This is the observed FCFE: the only cash a shareholder receives, and the realistic measure of distributable capital while core solvency falls (Group 158% -> 136% -> 132%; Sunshine Life 137% -> 110% -> 111%) despite record profit. OCF-less-capex (63,681 for FY2025) is policyholder float being invested, so the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income is deliberately not satisfied; reported_fcf retained for auditability only.
inputs.sbc_source: Metrics.csv/kpis: ShareRepurchases and EquityAwardTaxes 0 every period; no share-based payment scheme disclosed in the FY2025 AR. SBC genuinely zero, so house and street bases coincide and band_position collapses (null).
inputs.buyback_note: No buybacks in any year; share count 11,502m since the Dec-2022 IPO.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are RMB (CNY) millions; the HKEX quote is HKD. fx_rate converts model to quote: 1 CNY = 1.1748 HKD (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-24). No A-share listing to parity-check against; the H1 FY2026 interim quotes the FY2025 final dividend as RMB0.19 payable in HKD at the PBOC rate, consistent with this direction.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year CGB ~1.7-1.9% + China ERP ~6.5% x beta ~1.2 for a mid-tier H-share-only life/P&C insurer with falling solvency and no A-share liquidity = ~9.7%, rounded up to 11.0% base for the structural H-share discount, the size gap to China Life/Ping An/CPIC and the guarantee-insurance underwriting history (1336.HK New China Life uses 10.5%). Bull 10.0%, bear 12.0%. The company's own EV risk discount rate is 8.5%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases immaterial (lease liabilities RMB561m; principal repayments ~RMB0.3-0.5bn) and already inside profit before tax under IFRS 16; no separate charge.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI (~RMB264m FY2025 profit share, mainly Sunshine AMC ~20% and Sunshine Surety ~13% minorities) is deducted inside the combined tax-and-NCI rate (cash_tax_rate_path) so the FCFE is attributable to parent shareholders. Attributable net profit 6,307 of total 6,570 in FY2025.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Life/P&C insurer FCFE at cost of equity via the engine route (dividend-capacity model), the same family as 1336.HK, 2378.HK, PRU and LGEN.L -- NOT an owner-FCF DCF: an insurer's OCF (RMB64.3bn FY2025) is premium float being invested, not owner earnings, and EBITDA/net debt do not exist in the sense the default engine assumes. Mechanics: profit before tax = revenue x margin; a combined tax-plus-NCI rate gives attributable net profit; capex_pct is the retention plug (margin x (1 - rate) x (1 - payout)) so FCFE = attributable NI x payout. Debt interest is inside PBT so net debt is zero and nothing is deducted after the flows. SKILL.md routes insurers to BVPS x exit P/B; the engine FCFE route is used instead so the dashboard sliders, workbook and sanity-check exemption (earnings_at_coe) work by construction, with the BVPS/EV cross-check recorded in valuation_philosophy. Anchors: P/B 0.60x on attributable equity 55,337 (BVPS RMB4.81 = HKD5.65); EV RMB129,428m at 30 June 2026 = RMB11.25/share = HKD13.2, so the price is ~0.26x EV; trailing P/E ~5.2x; dividend yield ~6.6%.

embedded_value.source: FY2025 AR Embedded Value Report; H1 FY2026 interim Embedded Value Report

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2027-30 base revenue growth, between the 3yr revenue CAGR (6.9%) and the flat equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Attributable equity CAGR FY2022-25 of 0.1% (58,075 -> 58,201) diverges >30% from revenue (6.9%) and EPS (8.5%) CAGRs: under IFRS 17/IFRS 9 the OCI remeasurement of insurance liabilities as Chinese bond yields fell absorbed almost all retained earnings. Book value is not the compounding measure for this company; dividends and EV are.
historical_growth.notes: Only four annual periods exist (FY2022 restated to IFRS 17 at the 2023 adoption), so 5-year CAGRs are not available. FCF CAGR is on dividends paid (1,708 -> 1,993), the FCFE measure, not on reported OCF-less-capex (24,482 -> 63,681), which is policyholder float. EV grew 4.3% in FY2025 and 7.2% in H1 FY2026; VNB +48.2% in FY2025 and +16.4% in H1 FY2026.

base.payout_ratio_path_note: capex_pct = margin x (1 - 20% tax+NCI) x (1 - payout); payout 35, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 50, 50%
base.narrative: FY2026: revenue +3% (H1 +2.6%) at a 9.0% pre-tax margin = PBT ~8.8bn (H1 6,058 + a seasonally weak H2 ~2.7bn, vs 7,106 in FY2025; H2 FY2025 was only ~2.0bn), attributable NI ~7.0bn after a 20% combined tax-and-NCI rate (FY2025 11%, FY2024 33%, H1 FY2026 22%), dividend ~2.45bn (RMB0.21/share, payout 35%). FY2027: margin eases to 8.8% as FY2026 investment gains normalise toward the EV's 4.0% return, partly offset by the guarantee-insurance run-off (RMB1.51bn underwriting loss in FY2025 ceases). FY2028-31: revenue +5-5.5% on bancassurance regular premium, CSM (57.6bn) release and investment-asset growth; margin 9.0-9.5%. Payout rises ~2pp a year from 35% to 50% as the participating-product mix stabilises capital consumption and core solvency stops falling. Growth fades to 3% by FY2035. Terminal min(Gordon 11%/3%, 12x FCFE = 6x earnings at a 50% payout).

bull.payout_ratio_path_note: capex_pct = margin x 0.80 x (1 - payout); payout 36, 40, 44, 48, 50, 52, 54, 55, 55, 55%
bull.narrative: H1 FY2026 pace sustained: revenue +5-6.5%, margin rising to 11% by FY2031 as the guarantee book runs off, P&C combined ratio holds <99%, the New Sunshine Strategy cost programme compounds and VNB growth (+48% FY2025, +16% H1 FY2026) feeds CSM release. Solvency stabilises, payout steps to 55% by FY2033 (peer-level). CoE 10%, terminal min(Gordon 10%/3.5%, 14x FCFE).

bear.payout_ratio_path_note: capex_pct = margin x 0.80 x (1 - payout); payout held at 35% throughout
bear.narrative: A weak H2 FY2026 (A-share reversal, 10-year CGB below 1.7%) holds FY2026 margin to 7.5%, then the negative-spread squeeze on legacy guaranteed liabilities and auto-insurance price competition cap the margin at 6.5% (the FY2022-25 average). Sunshine Life core solvency (111%) keeps falling, so the payout is frozen at 35% and a capital raise becomes a live possibility (dilution not modelled). CoE 12%, terminal min(Gordon 12%/2.5%, 10x FCFE).

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-tier Chinese insurer growing with its bancassurance franchise, margins normalising to ~9-9.5% of total revenues, payout lifting from 35% to 50% over a decade as capital strain eases.
scenario_narratives.bull: Guarantee run-off and cost programme lift margins to 11%; VNB momentum sustains; payout reaches peer-level 55%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Falling Chinese rates and auto price competition hold margins at the FY2022-25 average; solvency keeps the payout frozen at 35%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: Group core solvency has fallen 26pt in 18 months (158% -> 132%) and Sunshine Life's to 111% despite record profit, 72% of the RMB640bn book is fixed income reinvesting into a 10-year CGB below 2%, and the guarantee-insurance wind-down shows the underwriting-risk history. Bull cut to 20% because it needs sustained ~11% margins the company has never reported on an IFRS 17 basis and a payout the solvency trajectory does not yet support.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a Chinese life/P&C insurer on the cash it can distribute, not on IFRS 17 net income (dominated by investment variance: EV investment experience variance was -RMB11.5bn in FY2025) and not on OCF (policyholder float). Profit before tax after a 20% combined tax-and-NCI rate is the earnings measure; the payout ratio, calibrated to the FY2025 dividend (34.6%) and the solvency trajectory, sets how much must be retained. Debt interest is inside PBT so net debt is zero. Cross-checks: EV RMB11.25/share (HKD13.2) at 30 June 2026 -- the base IV is ~0.3-0.4x EV and the price ~0.26x EV, a steeper discount than New China Life (price ~0.5x EV at its valuation) which reflects Sunshine's lower solvency, lower ROE and H-share-only float; BVPS RMB4.81 (HKD5.65) with P/B 0.60x; trailing P/E ~5x, yield ~6.6%. If Sunshine ever traded at New China Life's EV discount the share would be ~2x the base IV, which is why the bull case is not capped at the dividend model alone.
key_risks_to_valuation: Payout ratio: every 10pp of long-run payout is worth roughly 20% of base IV; a solvency-driven freeze at 35% is the bear case
Combined tax-and-NCI rate swings 11-33% year to year; 20% is a through-cycle assumption
Interest-rate / negative-spread risk on legacy guaranteed liabilities as Chinese long bond yields fall
A-share equity exposure (21% of investment assets) drives reported margin volatility
Possible rights issue or capital supplementary bond issuance if Sunshine Life core solvency keeps falling
Structural H-share discount to EV may persist indefinitely; the EV cross-check is not a catalyst
